description: This file contains the implementation of a custom HTML sanitization policy for the Apache OFBiz framework, using the OWASP HTML Sanitizer library. It defines rules for permitting specific HTML tags and attributes, primarily aimed at ensuring safe HTML content by preventing XSS attacks while allowing rich content.

classes.name: CustomPermissivePolicy
classes.description: A class providing a customized HTML sanitization policy based on OWASP standards, tailored for the OFBiz framework, allowing specific tags, attributes, and URL protocols.

methods.name: getSanitizerPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined sanitation policy object that encapsulates all attribute and element rules.
